question: When an in-zone paid promotable piece has no legal promotion action, is that because the square is no promotion source for its base type, because no allowed promotion destination is reachable, or because every promotion target is dead there?

design.replay_precondition: terminal status, winner and ply count must equal the stored values
design.contact_definition: unchanged from Stage 8: in-zone paid square that is the from_square of a legal BoardMove with promotion_target_id not None
design.idle_side_note: the evaluator pays either owner; legal_actions only ever contains the side to move, so idle-side observations are tagged and reported apart

defect_corrections.how_found: the independent per-case probe recorded 8 pseudo-legal-but-illegal promotions while this scan reported 6, all in seed 77
defect_corrections.cause: each game builds a fresh compiled ruleset; the released object's id was recycled, so a promotion table could be reused across seeds
defect_corrections.status: private and unpublished; no number from either run is used in a report

nonclaims: no rate contrast between the in-zone and outside-zone arms; the withdrawn contrast is not reproduced
no claim that any term changed a chosen action, an outcome or a strength
board 4, classic_like, these six stored game files only; deeper play and boards 6 and 8 are unmeasured
the partition is definitionally complete because a piece either has a legal promotion action or falls in one of the named structural cases; that completeness is not evidence
the idle-side split is descriptive: an idle piece has no legal action by the rules of turn order
